description: Implement join-based ordering that respects parent relationship scopes to prevent cross-context interference. When users reorder items within a specific parent relationship, ensure those operations only affect items within that same parent scope and don't leak to unrelated parent contexts.
functional_requirements: Generate reorder keys, lookup adjacent rows, and handle missing key backfill within the same join scope as the target item
Resolve fast drag/drop pending operations against scoped context before computing new ordering keys
Extract scoped query logic into focused helper functions while maintaining existing orchestration structure
Use shared constraint utilities instead of local implementations for consistency
